reviewer: Claude (Opus 5, Claude Code) -- main session, no subagents. All 55 sheets opened tile by tile in one pass, 2026-08-25 evening, against episode_spec.v001.json forbidden_subjects (118 terms) and the wrong-country failure that caused this rebuild.
review_method: Sheets rebuilt with 'py -3.11 scripts/check_shipped_frames.py --slug itaewon --sheets-only --force'. The 59 sheets from the 13:01 master were quarantined automatically to _superseded_sheets and were NOT read. 1098 frames from 272 cuts at 20/60/85/95 percent of each cut; coverage complete, no unsampled span over 4s across 0:00-31:35.
what_was_looked_for: wrong-country footage -- the defect that forced this rebuild: Chinese/Japanese signage, Shenzhen/Moscow/Taipei/Venice skylines, Chinatown, deep snow, non-Korean street furniture. For a Seoul film the ABSENCE of hangul is itself a tell.
identifiable real faces held in frame; real-person likeness
bodies, casualties, CPR, stretchers, rescue imagery (episode_spec forbids all)
readable documents, court filings, company logos, agency seals
depth maps staged as picture (the EP75 lahaina defect)

findings.wrong_country: ZERO. Every located clip reads Korea: Gwanghwamun, Gyeongbokgung, Cheonggyecheon, Namdaemun, the Han river bridges, Yeouido and the National Assembly, Yongin Everline, Bogwangsa, hanok villages, Korail rolling stock, Korean-plate police vehicles, hangul shopfronts throughout. Several shots are Busan or Chuncheon rather than Seoul; those are Korea-correct and carry no foreign tell.
